notes.title: Shaking up the meta!
notes.content:
Patch 0.5.5

Greetings Cropsters!

This balance patch aims to shake up the meta.
Venus Flytrap and Butternut Squash are seeing nerfs as they were very dominant.
Buffed builds include the new "Impairment" build, shrooms, fruits and roots.

Balance changes:

🟢Liquorice: 0.46 attack speed --> 0.48 attack speed
🟢Cinnamon: 500 range --> 580 range | 6 HP --> 7 HP | 0.46 attack speed --> 0.48 attack speed
🔴Venus Flytrap: 0.42 attack speed --> 0.37 attack speed
🔴Butternut Squash: Battlecry: Give all 3-tile crops +1 DMG & +2 HP --> Battlecry: Give all 3-tile crops +1 DMG.
🟢Redcap: 0.46 attack speed --> 0.52 attack speed.
🟡Morel: New ability: Gives +1 melee damage. | 2 DMG 8 HP --> 1 DMG, 6 HP | 2 field occupation --> 1 field occupation. //Dev comment: The game has been in need of the old cauliflower ability ever since it left. This is a buff to redcaps, tomato, pumpkin and melee builds in general! Also the Morel didn't really have any identity.
🟡Tomato: Ability text clarification: On Death: Explode, dealing its damage.
🟢Avocado: 400 range --> 460 range
🟢Onion: 17 HP --> 18 HP
🟢Apple: 5 HP --> 6 HP

Other:

Flame Totem (attack speed) has been temporarily disabled in duos due to the attack speed buff not transferring to teammate nor the database.

Fixes:

Fixed a bug where Cinnamon would not buff Jalapeño and Cayenne.
Now properly de-selects Cinnamon when you click on any loadout.
The bullets from Quinoa blast will only spawn particle effects as long as there are less than 32 bullets on screen. (To try to avoid crashing in massive quinoa-blasts in duos.)

As always, the PvP environment might contain unchanged crops for a few hours until it settles.
Thanks for your continued support for CROPS!
//Bocary

notes.title: SEASON 3 UPDATE
notes.content:
-- SEASON 3 BEGINS --
Your rank has been reset, and player icons have been awarded depending on your rank.

4 new crops join:

Wheat (Grain)
Barley (Grain)
Quinoa (Grain)
Venus Flytrap (Leafy)


New post-combat reward:

 Scarecrow. Gives +4 new fields and a 0 DMG 8HP Scarecrow that can be placed on the field.


The new grain build synergizes with having scarecrows.

Battlecry keyword added. This keyword triggers at the start of combat. It doesn't trigger on revive.

Balance changes & Updates:

🟡Redcap: Ability renamed to: "Battlecry: Spawn 2 clones"
🟡Garlic: Ability renamed to: "Battlecry: Gain Immunity (3s)"
🟡Corn Rework: 3 DMG --> 1 DMG | 11HP --> 8HP | Ability changed to: "Battlecry: Spawn a Scarecrow"
🟡Rice Rework: 1 field occupation --> 2 field occupation. | 1 DMG --> 2 DMG | 6HP --> 9HP | Ability changed to: "When picked: Also gain a Scarecrow"
🟡Cauliflower Rework: 4HP --> 6HP | Ability changed to: "Gives +3HP". //Dev comment: As rice had to be reworked to fit with the grain archetype, I wanted another crop to take over its old ability (it's neat to have in the game). Cauliflower seemed to suit the most.
🟢Charge field buff: +4 new fields --> +5 new fields.
🔴Carrot: 13HP --> 9HP
🔴Mangosteen: 0.22 Attackspeed --> 0.20 Attackspeed
🔴Apple: 4 DMG --> 3 DMG
🔴Banana: 15 HP --> 12 HP
🔴Chili: Ability changed to: "+1 DMG if touching 2 other Spice".
🔴Agility: No longer allows you to place your unit anywhere. Now makes the crop teleport to backline after 1 second. (Like the assassin rat from PvE).
🟡Slow mechanic reworked: No longer freezes when slowing for a second time. Instead, each slow will apply a stacking reduction to attackspeed (-0.05 attack speed per slow stack, capped at 0.10 attackspeed). Slow is now always permanent. //Dev comment: The freeze mechanic was fun to experiment with. It might come back as a crop-specific ability in the future, but for now, the grapes permafreeze was not fun to play against.


Other:

Added artist credits to all crops in the collection screen.
Adjusted the price to buy some crops (generally a little bit cheaper).
Made it possible to see crops abilities before you buy them, instead of keeping them secret.
Restructured the player icon screen with some new navigation buttons.
Every 3rd tick of drought will now increase drought damage by 1. This is to avoid Venus Flytraps with tons of damage making infinite rounds.

Rating system has been changed a bit for season 3: The requirements for ranks has increased:
Bronze: <1000 rating
Silver: 1000-1199 rating
Gold: 1200-1399 rating
Emerald: 1400-1599 rating
Diamond: 1600-1799 rating
Master: 1800-1999 rating
Grandmaster: 2000+ rating

Fixes:

Fixed a bug where the fiery ghost pepper player icon would not show properly in games.
Fixed a bug where lemon projectiles could be seen flying off-screen after the battle.
Hopefully fixed a bug where balance totem would not give unlimited range as expected.
Avocado infobox now correctly says "+2 DMG per unique adjacent root"
Hopefully fixed a rare bug that made the game crash for a few people on launch (caused by some corrupted file in the cache).

 
Expect balance changes and fixes in the coming days.

As usual, the PvP environment might still have old/unchanged crops from the old season. Give it a few hours to settle :)

//Bocary

notes.title: Root Update
notes.content:
Hi Cropsters!

In my endeavour to make more refined and better synergies in the game, fruits and roots are getting some love and changes!

Balance and changes:

🔴Armor is no longer a "counter" that is stackable. Armor is now simply a buff that makes a crop take -1 damage. Walnut now says "Has Armor" and flow totem says "Gives Armor". //Dev comment: This is essentially a "revert" of the armor stacking made possible in the last update, since it was too strong to have 2 armor on anything.
🟡Carrot: Ability changed to: "+3 HP per adjacent ROOT"
🟢Avocado: Ability changed to: "Knockback. +2 DMG per adjacent ROOT"
🟡Eggplant: Ability changed to: "+300 range per other adjacent ROOT"
🟡Apple: Ability changed to: "+1 DMG per unique adjacent FRUIT"
🟢/🟡Cabbage: Ability changed to: "+5 HP per other adjacent LEAFY"
🔴Ice Rat (PvE): 0.43 attack speed --> 0.39 attack speed
🟡Lemon: Now correctly says "+1 DMG if touching OTHER citrus"
🟡Cayenne: Now correctly says "+1 DMG if touching OTHER spice"
🔴Pumpkin: Now says "+1 DMG / +4 HP per unique adjacent type". //Dev comment: This is a slight nerf to pumpkin, but the point is to make the pumpkin build a rainbow-type build where you want 1 crop from each type. Maybe there will be another crop to support this archetype later!

notes.title: Balance patch
notes.content:
Greetings Cropsters!

A new patch just landed.

Balance:

🟢Dragonfruit: 530 Range --> 600 Range
🔴Starfruit: 9HP --> 7HP
🔴Apple: 2.5 movespeed --> 1.8 movespeed
🟡Garlic rework: 1.8 movespeed --> 2.0 movespeed | 20HP --> 17HP | Ability changed to: "Has immunity (3s)" | Shape changed to reverse starfruit shape. //Dev comment: Even though the drought ability was very innovative and cool in theory, it just wasn't healthy for the meta. Many people disliked it, and having an ability that basically counters every ranged combo is just too strong. We have cherry/agility/immunity that does that, but more balanced. Now it's just a pretty decent tank unit that synergizes with starfruit, as their shapes fit perfectly (the immunity also gives starfruit some time to charge!)
🟢Orange: 8HP --> 9HP | 400 range --> 450 range | 0.40 attackspeed --> 0.43 attackspeed //Dev comment: The slow removal from orange made it severely underperform. It is now getting some compensation in stats.
🟡/🟢Speed Totem rework: Now gives crop to the left unlimited range and crop to the right charge. Name changed to: Balance Totem. //Dev comment: The speed totem has just always been inferior compared to all other totems. This makes it a viable option, as many builds rely on unlimited range.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45068446/cdd6996bfa5a2b8bf838ff7689fefd506bbc6c69.png

Other changes:

Added the option to switch between type-view and compact-view in the loadout screen.
Christmas drops has been made a bit more likely to obtain. Legendary --> Epic | Epic --> Rare
The loadout can now only be edited from the play menu, and not in the collection tab. It was simply too much work to have it there, so i'd rather remove it for now and focus my time on new features.


Fixes:


Fixed a bug where non-English languages would cause errors.
Duos player database now properly expanded by 50%. (wasn't applied in duos by mistake)
Knockback buff has been removed as it was causing issues over and over. It will be replaced with a new reward that I've been cooking on.


*Keep in mind that old/unchanged crops might still linger in the PvP environment until new builds are uploaded. It will settle in some hours.

//Bocary

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45068446/5dbdd444dec3bc29113058a13d342bc7e5e8326d.jpg

* Ghost Pepper
* Wheat

Well met, cropsters.

notes.title: INTRODUCING: CROPS! DUOS
notes.content:
Introducing CROPS! DUOS

INVITE A FRIEND TO PLAY CROPS!

Crops! DUOS has 2 modes:


VERSUS: you and a friend plays a live 1v1 against each other! First to 10 stars wins.
CO-OP: you and a friend plays a 2v2 co-op game against 2 other players. You can also play this mode solo, and get teamed up with a random partner!.

notes.title: NEW CROPS (AND MORE)

Hello Cropsters!

This update mainly brings 4 new crops, a new totem and changes to some existing crops!
Also some QoL features and bugfixes.

Full patch notes:

New content & features:

New crops added to the game: Bamboo, Aloe Vera, Rice and Orange.
New totem added: Flow Totem. Gives +1 armor (makes the crop take -1 damage!)
Sudden death added. After 20s in a round, sudden death will happen dealing 1 true damage per second to all units.
Quick-plant added. By clicking an empty tile, you can now plant the last planted crop (if available in the basket).
Planting a crop on top of another crop will now throw the existing crop back into the basket.


Changes to current crops:

Avocado nerf: no longer stuns. HP Reduced from 6 (down from 7). Dev comment: Most crops are now able to hit the avocado before getting knocked back again, making it beatable in a 1v1.
Cauliflower change: HP reduced to 4 (down from 5). Only gives 1 adjacent melee crop +1 damage. Is now a single-tile crop.
Banana change: Now has 17 HP (down from 22) and 2 DMG (up from 1). Ability changed: Now has "Charge". Still has a pretty high attack speed compared to other crops, but not "very fast" like before. Dev comment: Banana was extensively being used as a tank, while the intention with banana was to be a melee carry unit. This change makes him more damage-oriented and versatile.
Liquorice Root HP Reduced to 15 (down from 16) Dev comment: This nerf is due to the new powerful combo liquorice root + orange.


Other + bugfixes:

Added more iconography to crop and totem infoboxes.
Fixed a bug where the "buy" button of crops would appear in wrong places.
Various small bugfixes.


You might still see old/unnerfed crops in PvP while it settles over the next 1-2 days.

If you havn't left a review for the game yet, feel free to do so!
It helps out A TON <3


Also join the discord: https://discord.gg/XkVtfNy6M2

notes.title: Game Launch!
notes.content:
Greetings, Cropsters!

The game has officially launched! HOORAY!

There has been many changes to the game over the past week (small and big!)
Getting PvP ready for launch took a lot of work.

As of now, anyone can play PvP except if you're based in China.
In that case, the only way for you to play PvP at the moment, is through the use of a VPN.
I am looking at solutions for this, but don't expect it to be solved within the next month.

As the PvP environment is slowly finding its place, I will start to work on balance changes in the coming few weeks.

There will also be new crops joining the fight in the foreseeable future!

Patch Notes:

All avatar prices has been significantly increased.
Totems in PvP will now be granted after round  6 rather than after your 5th win.
Flow totem has been temporarily disabled due to bugs. It will most likely be entirely reworked.
Health field buff now gives +4 health instead of +5.
Immunity field buff now provides +2 extra fields instead of +3.
Cherry is now able to charge after its roll attack!
You now have to place ALL your fields in "Manual Fields" mode in order to continue.
Stuns will now prioritize longest stun rather than most recent stun.
Bugfixes to Totems, PvP, field spawns and the Leaderboard.


...probably more stuff i didn't write down.

Thanks for your ongoing support for CROPS!
It means a lot.

Join the discord: https://discord.gg/XkVtfNy6M2

Greetings Cropsters!

Another localization has been added! These localizations have taken a lot of time. I will now shift my focus to adding some new content (New buffs, new crops etc.).

Here are the patch notes for now:


 The Brazilian Portuguese localization has been fully implemented.
 Font on the crops have changed for better readability.
 When booting up the game for the first time, the default language will now be the same language as your Steam client (if available).
 Fixed the screenshot button (F12) so that it now actually takes a Steam screenshot.
 Boar (grass miniboss) now has a little less base health, but scales up more health per round.


//Bocary

notes.title: German + Balance changes
notes.content:
Greetings Cropsters,

The German localization has been added to the game.

Other than that there's a few balance changes. Here are the patch notes:


 German localization added.
 Font changed for new field types (--> better readability).
 Agility (field buff) nerf: Now gives +3 fields instead of +4.
 Health (field buff) change: Now gives +5 health instead of +8, but gives +4 new fields instead of +3.
 Power (field buff) buffed: Now gives +4 new fields instead of +3.
 Bugfixes and localization fixes.


Currently brewing on some new content and more localizations.
Stay tuned

//Bocary

notes.title: 120 FPS update!
notes.content:
Greetings Cropsters!

As my mission for more QoL continues, I have made some nice improvements!


 You can now switch between 60/90/120 FPS in the settings menu. And what's even nicer: the game detects your monitor frequency and sets the FPS automatically so you don't even have to worry about it :)
 You can now click to instantly skip Victory/Defeat screen.
 Score calculation: Crops surviving in combat now gives +3 score per crop, instead of +1.
 Changed the font in the collection tabs for better readability.
 More localizations and localization fixes.


Also: I have been looking at some optimizations for the Steam Deck.
If you own a deck, you should give it a try. CROPS! plays great on deck!

Stay tuned

//Bocary
